_comment: Edit 'status' to 'Tested' when verified in-game. Edit 'name' to rename a group. Add cards to 'cards' array to reassign them. 'confidence'/'evidence' refreshed for v1.14.0 (2026-09-27) against .claude/playthrough-test-status.json; .audit/feature-map.md (untracked) still holds the full 2026-09-01 /feature-map citations.

groups.name: Wild Mushroom Foraging
groups.evidence: Features.json T1.5/T2.21 pass 2026-07-21 predates the 1.10.16 isClearing fix and everything since; 1.14.0 adds the Chaga chain and a Herbal Tonic effect stat (replacing permanent ImmuneSystem writes on Ginseng/Lion's Mane/Reishi/Shiitake/Black Trumpet/King Oyster - Medicinal Herbs and Truffle Chain groups share the same stat) - T2.289 pending. T2.171 (seasonal forage suppression for these species at vanilla forests) is pending again: the 09-23 PASS was invalidated by the r41 harness review 2026-09-26 as forced-not-observed and needs a real in/out-of-season rerun. Chaga itself is forage-gated at T2.291 (pending) and is deliberately year-round (T2.292, pending, and not yet in the deployed dev build as of 2026-09-27). Culinary powders (Black Trumpet/Shiitake/King Oyster Ground, 1.11.0) remain pending at T2.209.

groups.name: Truffle Chain
groups.evidence: No dedicated playtest item; TruffleFatCookPatch (old 0.25s poll) retired in favor of the same proven declarative Cook-stat pattern used by all mushrooms (CHANGELOG confirms removal). 1.14.0: Truffle Oil's Drink now also grants Herbal Tonic (+18, herbs_fungi_stat_herbal_tonic) in place of a permanent ImmuneSystem write (T2.289, pending). Truffle Butter and Truffle Salt (1.13.0) remain pending at T2.230.

groups.name: Foraged Berries
groups.evidence: T1.5 pass 2026-07-21 explicitly names the 4 species, but predates the 1.10.16 isClearing double-count fix (Redcurrant) and T2.171's still-pending seasonal-suppression re-verification - the base forage drops remain unconfirmed since. Berry Preserve (1.11.0, all 4 dried berries + honeycomb) is separately VERIFIED: T2.211 PASS 2026-09-25 (r41 harness review) covers craft, consumption, shelf life and Eat. That run was handed its Honeycomb: the game data of EA 0.68b placed no vanilla hive or skep. The Wild Bees' Nest that filled that gap (1.14.1) was removed with the Foraging Forest in 1.14.9; in EA 0.69c the vanilla Bee Skep blueprint (Farming > Animal Husbandry) gives Honeycomb, not yet checked in game with this mod.

groups.name: Medicinal Herbs
groups.evidence: T1.5 (2026-07-21) + T2.73 (2026-08-15, hot-water fail-message) both PASS, but Wild Flowers/Dandelion/Common Plantain/Chamomile/Yarrow are named in the 1.10.16 (2026-08-26) isClearing double-count fix and T2.171's seasonal-suppression re-verification is still pending - material change since pass. 1.13.1's Herbal Analgesic/Yarrow Clotting effect stats (replacing dead Pain/BloodLoss base writes on Yarrow/Dried Yarrow/Ground Yarrow) are T1.100/T1.101 PASS. 1.14.0 adds Plant Ginseng and Plant Yarrow (cultivation, gate = own herb on board, 14/5-day growth, 3-4 roots per harvest) and Ginseng/Reishi/Shiitake/etc's Herbal Tonic dosing-once fix (T2.288/T2.289 pending); Plant Ginseng/Plant Yarrow themselves are T2.293 pending. 1.14.1 adds Plant Chamomile, Plant Plantain and Plant Dandelion (Yarrow's 5-day growth and 3 to 4 yield copied as placeholders; their Harvest trains Herbalism); not checked in game.

groups.name: Peanut Cultivation and Products
groups.evidence: New group added 2026-09-01 (previously untracked - absent from prior Features.json and ModInfo.json Description, though README documents it fully); no dedicated playtest item; declarative CI/DA/BP chain identical in shape to proven Truffle/Hemp chains; files stable since 2026-06-23/2026-07-16. 1.14.0 adds Plant Peanuts (gate = 2 Raw Peanuts + hoe on fertile ground, 10-day growth, 3-5 pods per harvest, roasted peanuts do not sprout) - T2.294 pending.

groups.name: Mushroom Log Cultivation
groups.evidence: T2.20 pass 2026-07-21 confirmed the Progress-stat maturation timer on all 6 species and the 20-mushroom harvest, but predates 1.14.0's added Harvest yield (all 6 species now also drop 2-3 Wood Shavings + 1 Firewood on the same action, confirmed in JSON) - T2.295 pending re-verification of the enlarged harvest.

groups.name: Hemp Farming and Products
groups.evidence: T2.20 (2026-07-21) VERIFIED cultivation/harvest; Hemp Butter dead-end FIXED 1.10.17 (2026-09-01, Wetness started at 0 so its OnZero solidify-transform could never fire; now starts full at retuned max 96) and now CONFIRMED end to end: T2.153 PASS 2026-09-25 (r41 harness review) - Active Hemp Butter starts at Wetness 96, solidifies at zero into one Hemp Butter with spoilage carried (~20%), 3 doses, Mild/Medium/High give +60/+120/+180.

groups.name: Drying System
groups.evidence: No explicit playtest citation (T2.21 'remaining groups' spot-check plausibly covers it); minor 2026-07-31 recipe-yield tweak (quantity only, not structural). 1.13.7 fixed dismantling a Drying Stack or Drying Tray with trays/herbs still on it destroying the contents along with the frame - both now set contents down beside the player instead, matching the Wooden Pantry/Apothecary Shelf/vanilla drying rack pattern.

groups.name: Wooden Pantry
groups.evidence: No explicit playtest citation; simple proven Kit/Place/Dismantle pattern, file history stable

groups.name: Oil Press Station
groups.evidence: T2.18 pass 2026-07-21 explicitly names 'Oil Press Station'. Press Plate's GpTag_SharpAxe fix (1.13.2 - the tab group didn't exist, so the tool slot could never fill) is T2.245 PASS 2026-09-23 (TestHarness run, HerbsAndFungi 1.13.5).

groups.name: Herbal and Seed Oils
groups.evidence: T2.46 pass 2026-07-30 confirmed all 3 original herbal oil variants appeared in the Oil Press recipe list; Hemp/Truffle/Peanut oils use the identical mechanism. 1.11.0's three more herbal oils (Yarrow/Chamomile/Ginseng, pressed from the fresh herb + Clay Bowl, taking the press from 8 to 11 oils) are VERIFIED: T2.188 PASS 2026-09-25 covers all three end to end (recipe available, press selection, 1 herb + 1 bowl -> 1 oil, tag_Oil, Apply returns the bowl). Linseed Oil (1.11.0, 3 Flax Seeds + Clay Bowl, the Seed Bag perk's first use for flax) is also VERIFIED: T2.208 PASS 2026-09-25.

groups.name: Pickling System
groups.evidence: RESOLVED, upgraded from BROKEN. The 9-file flat-vs-nested DroppedOnDestroy defect (all 8 Ready/Sealed pickle vat variants plus OpenPickleJar.json) was fixed 1.10.18 (2026-09-05) and 1.13.5 (2026-09-19, the missing DropOnDestroyList:true flag). Core build/ferment/eat loop was VERIFIED via T2.19 (2026-07-21); the destroy-recovery sub-feature is now also VERIFIED: T2.117 (Uncap confirm popup), T2.118 (Ready vat destroy/spoil returns fired vat + Open Pickle Jar) and T2.172 (jar's Return Bowl returns a Clay Bowl) all PASS on 2026-09-25 (r41 harness review). Sealed vats have no removal path so their own drop was not separately exercised (DroppedOnDestroy-Reachable.Tests.ps1).

groups.name: Herb Pipe
groups.evidence: No explicit playtest citation; stable proven Load/Smoke/Empty declarative pattern

groups.name: Flower Garland
groups.evidence: No explicit playtest citation; simple proven pattern, purely decorative as designed

groups.name: Herbal Teas and Broth
groups.evidence: 4 of the original 10 liquids have working BPs verified via T2.18/T2.34 (2026-07-21)/T2.64 (2026-08-14); the other 6 remain a long-standing perk-spawn-only design gap (not flagged unreachable by acquisition-coverage audit, but not verified either). 1.11.0's three species broths (Reishi/Lion's Mane/Chanterelle, beside the existing Mushroom Broth) are VERIFIED: T2.210 PASS 2026-09-23 (receipts show all three brewed with their buffs applied on Drink). 1.14.0 adds Chaga Tea (strongest Herbal Tonic dose, +48) and fixes Ginseng/Lion's Mane/Reishi/Yarrow Tea double-dosing (brewing no longer doses the player; only Drink does) plus replaces their permanent ImmuneSystem writes with the same Herbal Tonic effect stat - T2.288 (dose-once) and T2.289 (Herbal Tonic) both pending.

groups.name: Medicinal Preparations
groups.evidence: No explicit playtest citation (T2.21 'remaining groups' plausibly covers it); proven BP+DA pattern, gates structurally sound. 1.13.1 replaced dead Pain-base writes on Plantain Poultice/Herbal Salve/Pain Relief Powder/Healer's Moss Tincture with a hidden Herbal Analgesic effect stat, carrying relief through a decaying status like vanilla medicines - T1.100 PASS. 1.14.0 removed Death Cap Tincture's lasting Pain increase (the card never mentioned pain); it still clears gut parasites and causes nausea - T2.290 pending.

groups.name: Apothecary Shelf
groups.evidence: 1.12.0 (plan row N10). T2.225 PASS 2026-09-25 (r41 harness review) covers reveal, build, filter, spoilage and Pick Up. Its filter accepts H&F herbs, fungi, powders and medicines by tag, which are H&F tags rather than vanilla ones.

groups.name: Incense Bundle
groups.evidence: 1.12.0 (plan row N11). T2.226 PASS 2026-09-25 (r41 harness review) covers build, lighting, the ambient effect, fuel drain, snuffing and burn-out.

groups.name: Character Perks
groups.evidence: No playtest item for the group as a whole; the 15 item-granting perks are structurally sound (correct PerkGroup GUID, correct WarpType companions) and Perk_ForestScout was removed in 1.10.15. Drying Kit's EquippedCardsWarpType fix is T1.122 PASS 2026-09-23. Pending: Herbalist's Advantage (1.11.0, the first stat-biasing perk: a starting Herbalism bonus) at T2.189, and the starting-stockpile weight check across 10 of the 16 perks at T4.41. 1.14.0 only reworded Add Fungi's description (it no longer names a season per mushroom). This group listed 15 UniqueIDs that no file carries (herbsfungiperk*) until 2026-09-27; it now names the real herbs_fungi_perk_* ids.
